verdict.rationale: Rootly ships AI agents (AI SRE, Rootly AI in Slack), so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents only Rootly's own MCP server, which exposes Rootly tools to external clients like Cursor or Claude Code. That is the server role, not the ability to connect third-party MCP servers. Its AI connectors (Atlassian, AWS, observability tools) are fixed first-party integrations, an adjacent feature with no documented MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
